title: Memory Update: New research findings from April 10 dream cycle
rationale: Log the three meaningful new findings from tonight's scan for future recall. Also update R29 research agenda with OU dynamic threshold amendment and R35 with EF clustering.
content:
## AI Research Findings (Dream Cycle 2026-04-10)

### RL for Speculative Pairs Trading — Optimal OU Thresholds (arXiv:2604.02035, April 2026)
- **Paper**: 'Reinforcement Learning for Speculative Trading under Exploratory Framework' — Zhao, Tse, Zheng. April 2026, q-fin.TR.
- **Spread model**: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. Optimal entry/exit formulated as sequential optimal stopping with Cox process intensities.
- **Key finding**: Optimal threshold is NOT fixed ±2σ. It depends on OU parameters θ (mean reversion speed) and σ (spread volatility). Closed-form Gibbs distribution optimal policy derived via Shannon entropy RL.
- **Practical rule**: Entry threshold calibrated to half-life = ln(2)/θ — fast pairs (< 3d) use ±1.5×σ_eq; medium (3-7d) use ±2.0×σ_eq; slow (> 7d) use ±2.5×σ_eq. Natural spread unit: σ_eq = σ/√(2θ).
- **R29 Amendment**: Fit OU parameters via MLE on 60-day spread history (already used for cointegration testing). Set dynamic entry thresholds per pair. ~20 lines of Python. No additional data required.

### Anonymization and Information Loss in Earnings Transcripts (arXiv:2511.15364, Nov 2025)
- **Paper**: 'Anonymization and Information Loss' — Wu, Yang, Ying. November 2025, q-fin.
- **Finding**: Anonymizing earnings call transcripts (stripping company names, numbers, product/geo mentions) causes MORE signal degradation than look-ahead bias. These tokens are the highest-density signal carriers for NLP sentiment/specificity scoring.
- **R31 Implementation Rule**: Use raw EDGAR transcripts with FinBERT. Never strip named entities, dollar amounts, or product names. EDGAR transcripts are public — anonymization has no privacy benefit and destroys signal.

### Markov Clustered Efficient Frontier for Portfolio Regime Detection (arXiv:2604.03946, April 2026)
- **Paper**: 'Asset allocation using a Markov process of clustered efficient frontier coefficients states' — Alexander, Scherer et al. April 2026. Code: https://github.com/nolanalexander/efficient-frontier-coefficients
- **Method**: Decompose rolling EF into 3 polynomial coefficients → hierarchical clustering → K market states → Markov transitions. Outperforms static benchmark portfolios.
- **Why relevant for R35**: Detects regimes from PORTFOLIO BEHAVIOR (how Sharpe/correlation structure of strategy mix shifts) rather than raw returns or VIX. Directly answers: 'Is our multi-strategy portfolio (PEAD + Div + Pairs + Put-write) in a favorable regime?'
- **R35 amendment**: Add EF clustering as primary portfolio-level regime signal. Use alongside Wasserstein HMM (return distribution) and skewness dispersion (leading indicator).

## Research Agenda Update (2026-04-10)

- **Round 29** — LLM semantic filter on equity pairs trading — QUEUED
  - **AMENDMENT (2026-04-10)**: Replace fixed ±2σ z-score entry with OU parameter-calibrated dynamic thresholds:
    - Fit θ, σ, μ via MLE on 60-day spread history (same data used for cointegration test)
    - Compute half_life = ln(2)/θ and σ_eq = σ/√(2θ)
    - Entry: spread > μ ± {1.5 if hl<3, 2.0 if hl<7, 2.5 otherwise} × σ_eq
    - Exit: |spread - μ| < 0.5 × σ_eq
    - Source: arXiv:2604.02035

- **Round 31** — Text-based PEAD — QUEUED
  - **IMPLEMENTATION NOTE (2026-04-10)**: Use raw EDGAR transcripts — do NOT anonymize before FinBERT processing. Anonymization destroys more signal than look-ahead bias. Source: arXiv:2511.15364

- **Round 35** — MRP Diagnostic + Regime Detection — CONCEPT
  - **AMENDMENT (2026-04-10)**: Add Markov Clustered Efficient Frontier (arXiv:2604.03946) as 3rd regime signal:
    - Primary: EF coefficient clustering (portfolio-level, uses strategy returns, has code)
    - Confirmation: Wasserstein HMM (arXiv:2603.04441) — return distribution level
    - Leading: Skewness dispersion (arXiv:2604.07870) — early warning
    - Fast-fail: VIX > 30 / SMA crossover (stays in R28 RegimeGuard)
